title: Light within an anomalous cloud
place: Garden near Weaverthorpe, looking towards Foxholes
summary: A couple saw a sun-like sphere apparently generating a small cloud climb rapidly, leaving a spiral trail, and photographed it.

title: Orange lights in the sky
summary: A pre-dawn driver saw three stationary orange spheres stacked vertically beside a farm's lights.

title: Ovoid shape in the sky
summary: Two plasterers saw a grey coffee-bean shaped object drop through a cloud, rotate, then race off horizontally towards Cleethorpes.

title: Cigar-shaped object in the sky
summary: A walker saw a black cigar-shaped silhouette move slowly north in the south-east sky; it was gone when he looked back.

title: Oval in the sky
summary: A walker saw an oval object with a silver centre and white rim dive down and fly fast along a hedgerow into a field.

title: White lights in the sky
summary: A witness saw nine star-like lights crossing east to west, four holding formation while the others swapped positions at speed.

title: White lights in the sky
place: Quarry Lane roundabout, A174 between Marske and Saltburn
summary: After a night shift, a driver found himself stopped watching two golden orbs move in tandem overhead in a muffled silence, then reached home about 40 minutes later than he should have.

title: White light in the sky
place: Fields between Middleton on the Wolds and Wetwang
summary: A bright, slow ball of light made a gentle half-circle turn near Wetwang's southern edge before disappearing into cloud.

title: Large black cat
summary: Two night-shift workers saw a very large black cat with a long tail glide across a road inside the secure industrial site.

title: Black oval in the sky
summary: A woman watched a matte black, flat-looking oval tumble slowly westward over houses in clear daylight.

title: White light in the sky
place: A614 near Middleton on the Wolds
summary: A family driving at night watched a star-like light dart, stop dead, climb vertically and hover far more nimbly than an aircraft.

title: Shadow creature
summary: A nine-year-old boy in 1970 saw the shadow of a man with a dog's head cross the curtained window; nobody was found outside.

title: Orange light in the sky
summary: A dog walker saw a solid orange object move steadily across the sky for a minute or two before blinking out.

title: Silver object in the sky
summary: A driver saw a wingless silver-grey object, bulbous at the front, move slowly towards old RAF Driffield; bird flocks behaved oddly afterwards.

title: Shadow figure and missing time
summary: During a storm a man saw a black shadow form enter the tent towards the children, and his partner saw a mist over them; he reportedly went out for an hour with no memory of it.

title: White orb and time slip
place: Campsite at Eastnor Castle deer park
summary: A couple at a festival watched a small self-lit orb wander into their tent and trace figure-eights over the stove; afterwards nearly two hours had passed unnoticed.

title: Rotating wheel of foliage
summary: A supporter's handwritten report (image only on the page) describes a flying rotating wheel of foliage near Bempton Chalet Park.

title: Large disc over the road
summary: Drivers in a traffic queue on the A1 watched a dull metallic disc as wide as a football pitch with coloured lights drift low across the road; the same witness also saw a large light release and recall two small lights over the Calder Valley.

title: Flashes in the sky
summary: A couple watching the ISS saw repeated very bright flashes in a different part of the sky and filmed one.

title: Giant green neon rings
summary: A witness saw giant linked green neon rings followed by a military jet at about 1,000ft.

title: Oval UFO with dark green light
summary: A resident saw a bright green oval zigzag through clouds and stop beside the neighbour's roof, flying off silently when he opened the window.

title: UFO with lights
summary: Two people saw a still oval of green and red lights that moved, dropped straight down and swept away, dwarfing a plane; a relative had odd time distortion near Blackstone Edge.

title: Bright light
place: Filey cliffs/country park, seen from Danes Dyke clifftop
summary: A morning walker at Danes Dyke photographed a stationary strong light apparently on or over Filey cliffs in misty weather.

title: Bright orange spheres
summary: A witness saw at least three intensely orange glowing orbs move erratically and fade in and out silently for about five minutes.

title: Large orange sphere
place: Bempton cliffs, looking towards Staple Newk
summary: Three men including a serving soldier watched an orange-red sphere sit on the cliff for up to 20 minutes, then jump hundreds of yards in seconds and hover over the path.

title: Light beam from the ground
summary: A farmer photographed a solid tube of white light rising 60–100ft from a harvested field that then sank back into the ground; thermal scanning found nothing.

title: Green being
summary: A sceptical mother woke to a small naked green being with kind eyes at her bedside that seemed to try to communicate, then floated out through the window.

title: Silver object in the sky
summary: An early-morning observer photographed a shiny silver object moving faster than an airliner and silently.

title: Strange light near Vega
place: Old Hull–Barnsley railway path off Calvert Lane, Hull
summary: Two colleagues watched a star-like point zigzag around Vega before shooting off; the same man later saw odd flashing lights near Vega from Wetwang.

title: Big cat
summary: A dog walker saw a black leopard-like cat stalking a hedge 30m away; separately she heard an unearthly metallic screeching in woods near Danby.

title: Poltergeist projectiles
summary: A family group visiting Fort Paull heard and saw pebbles strike a wall and one of them with no thrower present; their car later filled with an ancient musty smell.

title: Light in the sky
summary: Paul filmed a light that burst into view over the sea and vanished silently, shortly after another further down the coast.

title: Orange light in the sky
summary: A couple walking the beach photographed bright orange balls appearing one after another before fading after two minutes.

title: Big cat
summary: A driver braked for a cougar-sized black cat with a long tail that crossed the road; dashcam caught only a black blur.

title: Yellow eyes in darkness
summary: Driving at dawn, a greenkeeper saw a pair of glowing yellow eyes about a metre off the ground and widely spaced cross the road, with no visible body.

title: White light following a car
place: Country lane near Borough Green, Kent
summary: A mother and daughter saw a cricket-ball-sized white light pace their car at the driver's window before veering over the hedge.

title: Moving white light in the sky
summary: A driver followed a fast bright white ball for nearly a minute until it dimmed to a dark ball and was lost over the moors towards Denshaw.

title: Photographed light in the sky
place: Moor-top car park on the A169 above Sleights, near RAF Fylingdales
summary: A visitor photographed a slowly moving bright object over the moors near Fylingdales in afternoon daylight.

title: Filmed moving lights
summary: Paul and Bob Brown filmed a slow white light that turned out to be accompanied by other spheres moving in different directions.

title: Filmed moving lights
summary: Paul filmed several silent moving lights over Bempton; review of the footage showed six objects, more than were seen by eye.

title: More lights over the sea
summary: A man on the Esplanade saw two identical sweeping orange flashes far out to sea, then a silent white-yellow light that went out as he watched.

title: Giant feline
place: Humber foreshore beneath the Humber Bridge, Hessle
summary: A diver receiving decompression treatment saw a big cat 50m away on the riverbank; they stared at each other before it slipped into the woods.

title: White flash and light
summary: A skywatcher saw an intense white flash followed by a white ball shooting east into cloud.

title: Transparent orb and two ghost photos
summary: The same witness saw a translucent grey orb exit and pass through walls in her bedroom, found an unexplained painless puncture wound, and shares photos showing faces at York and Bodmin pubs.

title: Black ball in the sky
summary: From her bedroom a woman watched a small black rugby-ball shaped object tumble, pause, change shape and fly off west in daylight.

title: Red light in the sky
place: Moorland ridge above Buckstones Road, Shaw
summary: A dog walker saw a silent red flashing light race along the moor ridge and disappear abruptly after ten seconds.

title: The Glenferness Hand
place: Iron bench on the Findhorn gorge path, Glenferness estate
summary: A couple sitting on a bench by a cliff face felt and saw a hairy, ape-like hand dart out of solid rock and grab the woman's hip before vanishing.

title: Three sightings of orange lights
summary: Paul saw orange spheres flash on and off over the sea off South Landing and towards Speeton; the same night a driver near Langtoft and another observer reported similar lights.

title: Red blob in the sky
summary: While reeling in his daughter's kite, a man saw a red amorphous blob materialise beside it for a few seconds and fade away.

title: Blue lights and blobs in the sky
summary: A resident photographed and filmed two bright blue circles moving low, silently and in a straight line behind cloud over his house at 12.30am.

title: Huge black object in the sky
summary: Boys from a children's home on a night walk saw a silent, lightless black mass fill the sky above them; staff hurried them back to the minibus.

title: Blue orb and time loss
place: Road approaching New Earswick, north of York
summary: A woman driving from Haxby saw a blue glowing orb drop onto her car's front corner; everything was oddly silent, the trip took about an hour instead of 15 minutes, and the indicator was found smashed and coated in strange fluid.

title: Orange lights in the sky
summary: An angler saw five orange lights blink on and off over the horizon off Aldbrough around 2000, and in 2019 orange orbs glowing in clouds off Scarborough, followed by two jets.

title: Falling white light with a tail
summary: A child in 1968 saw a comet-like white ball with a green tint fall from the sky and apparently hit the ground with red sparks but no sound.

title: White lights in the sky
place: Bempton cliffs near the old RAF buildings
summary: A lone night walker and friends in a car saw two white lights swaying side to side near the RAF bunkers for 10–15 minutes, retreating when approached.

title: Lights and a UFO in the sky
place: Weaverthorpe and Butt Lane near Wold Newton
summary: A couple near Weaverthorpe saw two huge orange spheres over the Wolds, then many dull red spheres flying erratically near Octon, and the same lights repeatedly following a route over their home.

title: White UFO with a tail
place: A438 between Sledge Green and Rye Street
summary: Hitchhiking at 3–4am, a man saw a very bright white light charge up above the clouds and streak off westward leaving a short tail.

title: Red UFO in the sky
place: Road between Driffield and Hutton Cranswick, towards Southburn
summary: A driver saw a massive red disc with two spinning green wheel-like discs fly low over busy traffic towards Southburn.

title: Small dark ball in the sky
summary: A couple on a walk watched a small solid black ball fly in a straight line at constant height among birds; no wings or propellers were visible.

title: Out-of-body experience
summary: A man had an out-of-body experience in a hotel room and saw three entities, one mummy-like, approach his sleeping girlfriend until he cried out and woke.

title: White flash
summary: Paul and a friend in misty conditions saw the whole cove, sea and cliffs, flooded with white light from no visible source for about ten seconds, twice.

title: Red light in the sky
summary: On honeymoon, a man outside a village pub saw a silent red light pass over that seemed to reveal a cloaked outline, heading towards Kendal.

title: Triangles in the sky
summary: At dawn a resident watched a dark cloud over the sea break up and reform into three solid pyramid shapes lined up on the horizon, and hid in fear.

title: Red light above a helicopter
place: Driffield Road / old Nafferton Slacks Road junction, Nafferton
summary: A driver saw a sparkling red ball descend to hover above a searching helicopter, then shoot off towards Bridlington.

title: Light in the sky with jets
summary: A Bempton couple watched four low military jets manoeuvre around a glowing green orb in the evening sky.

title: UFO chasing a car
summary: Four soldiers driving at 2am were overtaken by a huge spinning silver disc ringed with white lights, passing silently about 200ft above.

title: Orange light in the sky
place: Over the sea between Filey and Speeton
summary: A couple driving at night saw a large orange ring-shaped light just offshore, later appearing as a line of orange light; a phone photo was taken.

title: Silver object in the sky
summary: At lunchtime a man saw a smooth white triangle jerk and spin above a jet, which seemed to swerve, before it headed down the coast.

title: Silver object in the sky (Ings Road)
place: Ings Road estate, East Hull (object over Bilton/Sproatley)
summary: Prompted by an inner voice, a man watched a polished silver cylinder move slowly and silently across the sky for 15 minutes in summer 2001.

title: Mysterious objects in the sky
summary: An aircraft enthusiast saw three high, fast objects in a perfect triangle with no contrails go behind a cloud and not emerge.

title: UFO seen by two people
place: B1253 Sledmere to Bridlington road near Sledmere
summary: Paul and a sceptical workmate watched a huge long white pulsing object hang over a field in afternoon daylight for five minutes before vanishing; a couple reported a silver disc on the same road in 1990.

title: Brief light-in-the-sky reports along the coast
place: North Landing and the Yorkshire coast
summary: A compilation of sea anglers' accounts of rows of orange lights strobing offshore from Runswick to Aldbrough, including a North Landing report that led to a lifeboat and Sea King search finding nothing.

title: Ghostly visitor
summary: A new resident woke to an elderly stooped man with a stick telling her it was his house; he apologised and vanished, and she later recognised him in an old village photo.

title: Lights in the hedge
place: Langtoft–Sledmere road at the Butterwick crossroads
summary: Paul and Steve Ashbridge repeatedly saw pale white and red lights drift through the roadside hawthorn hedge without lighting anything, vanishing when approached, during their Wolds skywatches.

title: Lights in the sky
summary: Driving to her horses, a woman saw a glowing orange globe jump between positions, then three in a row turn together and vanish over the sea.

title: Lights in the sky
summary: Paul and two friends filmed golden spheres behind cloud with a night-vision camera, invisible to the naked eye, binoculars and thermal scope.

title: Unidentified lights in the sky
summary: A retired police officer and her retired-pilot husband watched a red and a white light move slowly and silently over rooftops, then disappear behind a sycamore.

title: Triangle of red lights
place: Hedon to Burstwick road near the Weghill Road turn
summary: A driver saw three solid red lights switch on in a triangle and fly in formation south towards the Humber; a deep boom had been felt on the farm a couple of nights earlier.

title: Giant black cat
summary: A night taxi driver saw a jet-black Labrador-sized cat with a long thick tail bound across the road in front of him.

title: Lights in the sky
summary: During a December 2020 flap, a Leeds photographer captured a sequence of orange lights over the sea off North Landing; Paul saw splitting orange lights from Bempton the next night and a white light was reported near Sandsend.

title: Moving light in the daytime sky
summary: A couple leaving friends' house saw a glass-bright light for five seconds; the husband later said it was pyramid-shaped.

title: Ghost of an elderly lady
summary: A hotelier helping clean rooms saw a solid-looking elderly woman in old-fashioned clothes walk into bedroom 1, which was then empty; his wife had seen her twice before.

title: Various experiences
summary: One correspondent recounts a mercury-like orb over Aberdeen followed by shadow figures and poltergeist activity, a red blob beside his daughter's kite in Hemingbrough, a farmhouse apparition, and a blinding flash near Eggborough power station.

title: Black dot in the sky
place: Beside the River Trent, near RAF Scampton area
summary: A mother and child saw a fighter-sized black dot hover motionless a few hundred metres up, then dart sideways at a speed unlike any local military jet.

title: Bright white/yellow light in the sky
place: Over the LUK factory, Wales Bar, seen from the Aston–Kiveton road
summary: Driving to work around 1992 a miner saw a stationary white-yellow ball of light hanging over an industrial estate, which shot straight up and vanished.

title: Lights in the sky and a black triangle
summary: A couple saw a large blue neon boomerang-shaped object two weeks running, once circled by an orange orb, and later a silent black triangle with three white corner lights glide over the trees.

title: Rotating lights in the sky
summary: Boys playing out around 1981 saw a stationary row of slowly rotating white lights under the cloud base for about a minute; it was gone when they looked again.

title: Flash of light in the sky
summary: A walker at Bempton on a dull afternoon saw an extremely bright star-shaped flash burst out of the clouds, unlike lightning.

title: Big black feline
summary: A commuter driving from Flamborough to Speeton saw a big black cat drinking at Buckton pond; it looked at her and slipped into the hedge.

title: Moving lights in a triangular cluster
summary: Three fixed orange lights flew slowly and silently over a house, were met by a red flashing light, and moved off together in a triangle.

title: Cluster of moving lights
place: Edge of Gainsborough, towards Foxby Hill
summary: While watching Starlink satellites, a couple saw a small fuzzy triangle of four or five lights revolving around each other cross silently overhead in about 15 seconds.

title: Creature seen in a wood
place: Field by Swinemoor School via Fotherby Walk, Bridlington
summary: Around 1988 a man saw a huge ginger cat-like animal walk behind a slim tree and fail to reappear; his companion saw nothing.

title: Light that followed a car
place: A61 between Ripon and the A1, towards RAF Leeming
summary: An RAF engineer and friends driving back from Ripon saw an orange ball rise from a field and leap towards their car, pacing them before vanishing; the memory resurfaced decades later in matching dreams.

title: Craft flying overhead
summary: A farmer and his lodger saw a silent off-white oval craft about 80ft long with a rust-red stripe roll gently as it passed over at about 300ft in June 2019.

title: Strange animal
summary: A rock angler night fishing in 2018 saw an animal as tall as a Great Dane, cat-like with a long back, stroll along the cliff base and bound up the beach path.

title: Orange lights in the sky
summary: During documentary filming in February 2020, six observers including Paul Sinclair watched vivid orange spheres pop in and out over the sea for two hours after a triangle of lights was reported from Scarborough.

title: Thin ghostly figure (sea angler)
place: Hornsea beach by the sea wall
summary: A night angler saw a small thin all-black figure walking the shoreline that froze when noticed and pixelated away; he then appeared to lose around 80 minutes.

title: Werewolf-like animal
summary: A couple at North Landing saw a huge dog-like animal sitting on a rock outcrop that no camera would record; it growled and slunk off on all fours.

title: Three aerial object reports, one from an MOD officer
summary: An MOD project manager and his wife watched seven fast orange-white lights over the coast; through binoculars one was a rotating bronze triangle. Later sightings included two round objects overhead and a 2016 light with apparent lost time.

title: Sparkling red object
summary: At 1am a Bessingby resident watched a silent cluster of sparkling red lights, like red diamonds, bob up and down before vanishing.

title: Orange lights over the sea
place: Filey Country Park, overlooking Filey Bay
summary: After a beach run, a man saw three dull orange lights switch on in a horizontal line over the middle of the bay, then go off together after two seconds.

title: Giant feline
place: Denbigh Moors (Mynydd Hiraethog), near a stone circle
summary: A couple driving slowly across the remote Denbighshire moors around 2015 saw a grey cat the size of a springer spaniel run across the road.

title: Giant figure
summary: Youths at a night fire in Danes Dyke were watched by a silent figure well over 7ft tall that ignored shouts and banging; as they fled it leapt down into the dyke.

title: Silvery object in the sky
place: Bessingby Hill / West Hill near Bridlington Hospital
summary: Two boys in 1966 hid as a seamless silver-blue wedge-shaped craft shimmering at its edges hung silently above the trees, clunked loudly, then jumped across the sky and vanished.

title: Fifteen oval spheres in the sky
place: Off Flamborough Head, seen from Bridlington Bay
summary: At 3.30am a witness watching through binoculars saw a row of 15 oval spheres of light over the sea off the headland, with a similar formation apparently on the cliffs; another observer watched for over half an hour.

title: Disc in the sky
place: Staxton, looking over the Carrs towards Oliver's Mount
summary: The Staxton witness of report 5 adds that after seeing the moon-like white disc he was hit by sudden terror at home, then oddly forgot about it until next morning.

title: Funnel-shaped object and lights
place: Tunnel Pits, Epworth lane near Wroot
summary: Driving home in 1988, a mother and son saw a vast funnel-shaped orange beam reaching the ground, with several red and green objects spiralling down around it; they fled in fear.

title: Oblong object in the sky
summary: On a summer evening a man saw a small dark grey slant-sided craft with a yellow light drift silently at walking pace along a field edge; his friend's photos showed only a distant grey ball.

title: Object flying alongside cars
place: A165 between Fraisthorpe and Wilsthorpe roundabout
summary: Two women saw a towering object with two red lights moving alongside their car in a roadside field, after a car ahead swerved; at the roundabout it rose and shot out to sea (closely matches report 3).

title: Lights in the sky
place: Ulrome beach, near the wind farm view
summary: An ex-trawlerman beach fishing at Ulrome saw dark red lights over the sea, then five hanging over Flamborough Head, which switched off together; he was sure they were not flares or aircraft.

title: Lights in the sky
summary: At a farm barbecue around 1993 two people saw three lights travel in sync towards the sea, twist around each other, then race away over the water.

title: Balls of light in the sky
place: Bowgie Inn car park, Crantock, Cornwall
summary: Over 100 people at a pub car park in 2009 watched large balls of light stream in from the sea and fields and merge into a stationary silent craft, which later left at great speed.

title: UFO over a pirate radio ship
place: Bridlington Bay, Radio 270 pirate radio ship
summary: In summer 1966 a Radio 270 DJ described live on air a large luminous white sphere sitting above the ship's mast; a lightship off Spurn reportedly saw a similar sphere the same night.

title: Strange creature ran across the road
summary: Two women driving from Flixton had to brake for a hair-covered creature that crossed on all fours like a clumsy human, then leapt a long way into a field; they estimated it at 8ft standing.

title: Metallic tic-tac shaped object
place: M62 eastbound just before junction 38 (North Cave)
summary: A driver saw a featureless polished metallic tic-tac shaped object, roughly bus-sized, hovering motionless in daylight near North Cave.

title: Strange light over the sea
summary: A witness saw a series of repeatedly appearing lights off Flamborough Head, reported them to police as possible distress flares, and was told by the coastguard no military operation was under way.

title: The Ghost of Big Railings
place: Former RAF Bempton radar site, Bempton cliffs
summary: Paul Sinclair, out at night by the old Bempton bunker, saw a white light that vanished, a friend on the phone heard robotic voices, and a low hum surrounded the group for around 15 minutes.

title: Orange light flickering in response to other lights
place: Flamborough Head car park by the Caravel bar
summary: A family parked at Flamborough Head in 1983 watched a football-sized orange light over the sea blink on and off for 40 minutes, apparently in time with the faulty flashing sign of the clifftop bar.

title: Large white circular object
place: Staxton, looking over the Carrs towards Oliver's Mount
summary: Driving into Staxton around 1am, the witness saw a brilliant white circular object the size of a full moon hanging low over the fields.

title: Black triangle in the sky
place: Above Ganstead, seen from Holderness Road (A165)
summary: A driver heading to Bilton saw a dark triangle, lit faintly from its far side, hanging or drifting silently over Ganstead in late 1998.

title: UFO seen in a field by two women
place: A165 between Fraisthorpe and Wilsthorpe roundabout
summary: Two women driving the A165 saw an enormous silent object with two red lights pacing their car in the field beside the hedge; at Wilsthorpe roundabout it turned, climbed and sped out to sea.

title: Large orange light off Flamborough Head
place: Above Flamborough Head, seen from Bridlington seafront
summary: A visitor walking back along Bridlington seafront saw a huge orange disc of light hanging above Flamborough Head beside a fishing boat's lights; it vanished within about three seconds.

title: Crash on the roof, then a light
summary: A York man woken at 4am by a crash-like noise on his roof went outside and watched a silent, very bright white light that pulsed, seemed to approach, then sped away after about four minutes.
